purpose: Freeze the real but result-free capture implementation for the two inputs to the NaiveRAG encoder parity decision before loading the model, starting a service, collecting a vector, or reading any benchmark score.
scientific_boundary: The future capture observes only twelve fixed diagnostic text embeddings. It does not read Mem-Gallery examples or answers, run a memory method, produce a prediction, evaluate a metric, or select a favorable comparison.

model_preflight.fresh_validation: Before each future capture, require the signed materialization record and inventories, reject symlinks/path escapes/additions/omissions, and recompute SHA-256 for all 24 current model files rather than trusting size or a stale receipt.

fresh_root_protocol.root: An absent non-symlink exact child of an explicitly allowed project run scope.

covered_invariants: complete signed model snapshot acceptance followed by current-byte tamper rejection
both capture payloads are directly accepted by the frozen parity auditor
probe denominator, dimension, numeric, finite, and nonzero checks
complete signed direct capture root with zero scores
endpoint service identity binding and persistence
float16 or otherwise drifted service rejection
terminal failure evidence and no same-root retry
backend/service cross-binding rejection before output creation
existing, nested, and incomplete-identity output rejection

execution_order_after_resource_release: accept the WMA Wave 1 release receipt and prove its GPU processes, ports, and tmux sessions are absent
materialize and independently accept the frozen 24-file GME snapshot
capture direct LMEncoder probes in a fresh root, then terminate the direct process and release its GPU
start a separately frozen float32 loopback vLLM service and emit its READY_FOR_PARITY_PROBE receipt
capture the endpoint probes in one request, stop the service, and emit a stop receipt
run the already frozen parity auditor in a third fresh root and follow exactly its accepted branch
next_gate: Freeze the float32 service start/stop receipt generator and the controller that composes the two capture roots with the already frozen parity audit; execute only after the WMA release and GME materialization gates accept.
authorization: This implementation freeze authorizes no model acquisition, model read, model load, GPU process, service, endpoint request, dataset access, prediction, score, comparison, claim, cleanup, or table mutation.
